youtube.title: Why do keys have *random* bumps? 🔑 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The varying heights of the teeth on a key, called bitting, correspond to the internal pin tumblers in the lock. When the key is inserted, these bumps lift the pins to the exact shear line.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
